text: Weekly quality review, week 38. Overall the queue was healthier than last week: first response time dropped to just under four hours on email and stayed below two minutes on chat, even with the Tuesday outage on the tracking page. The main driver of volume was still WISMO, roughly 41% of new contacts, followed by damaged items and refund status questions. We saw a small increase in chargeback threats, which we think is linked to the new payment provider taking longer to release refunds; finance is aware. In the sample of 60 tickets I reviewed, tone was generally good, but several replies promised delivery dates we cannot control, which is exactly what the carrier macro is designed to avoid. One example worth discussing as a team is #603317, where the agent offered a full refund and a replacement at the same time without a supervisor sign-off; please remember goodwill above 25 GBP needs approval. Internal notes are also getting shorter again: a note that says only 'called, sorted' does not help the next agent who picks up the contact. Finally, thank you to everyone who covered the Saturday shift during peak prep, and a reminder that the new returns flow goes live on the 1st, so please read the updated knowledge base article before then.
note: Single ticket number buried in a long quality review.

text:
Please proofread this knowledge base article before I publish it.

Title: Handling 'item not received' (INR) contacts

1. Greet the customer by name using the {{customer.first_name}} placeholder. Never type the name by hand, the macro does it.
2. Ask for the order number. Parcelio order numbers follow the format ORD-XXXX-XXXX; tracking numbers start with PCL followed by ten digits and a country code.
3. Check the carrier events. EX02 means an address problem, EX07 a refusal, DLV a completed delivery. If the tracking page returns a 404 or 502, ask the customer to retry later and check the status page.
4. If the last scan is DLV and older than 48 hours, open a carrier claim. For DPD and Evri, use the claim portal; for Royal Mail, use the online form.
5. Offer goodwill only within the limits: up to 25 GBP without approval. Above that, ask your team lead (currently Nadia for the early shift and Oskar for the late shift).
6. Close the ticket with the INR-resolved tag and the reason code.

Example conversation (fictional): 'Hi Jane, I'm sorry your parcel hasn't arrived. Could you confirm your order number, for example ORD-0000-0000?'

Remember: SKUs like PMB-M-100 are public and can be shared freely. Account numbers must never be posted in public channels or social media replies.
note: Long negative full of lookalikes: placeholders, masks, codes, SKUs, team lead names, fictional example name.
